+ */
+class StaticImportFormatter : FormatterFunc, Serializable {

+  override fun apply(input: String): String {

+      Triple(

+      ),
+      Triple(

+      ),
+      Triple("TimeUnit", "java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit", "[A-Z][A-Z_0-9]*"),
+      Triple(
+        "StandardCharsets",
+        "java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets",
+        "[A-Z][A-Z_0-9]*"
+      ),
+    )
